newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Ryan Hotels says trading ahead of last year.
newsitem.headline: Ryan Hotels says trading ahead of last year.

text.p: Irish hotel chain Ryan Hotels Plc said on Wednesday that trading so far in 1997 had exceeded that of last year.
The group said in a statement that it was on target for another record breaking level of profits for the coming year.

I am pleased to be able to say that trading to date is running ahead of last year and that we have experienced no evidence of a slowing down in demand in spite of the increased competition from new properties," chairman Conor McCarthy told shareholders at an annual meeting.
McCarthy said barring unforseen circumstatnces the group was on target for "another record-breaking level of profits" in 1997.
